UN Report Details Foreign Support Fueling Sudan War, Possible War Crimes

A United Nations report indicates that foreign support and drone usage are fueling the ongoing war in Sudan, exacerbating violence against civilians and suggesting possible war crimes. The report highlights the involvement of foreign fighters and support networks in the conflict. Additionally, Uber has announced its withdrawal from Nigeria and Uganda, impacting numerous drivers.
